Grade: Grade 3
Subject: MOVEMENT AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
Strand: LISTENING
Topic 3.1: Elements of AND RESPONDING

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Elements of AND RESPONDING, part of LISTENING in Grade 3 MOVEMENT AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES.

Key inquiry question: How does it make you a) express initial personal as sad, happy feel?
